library: preserve native checkbox activation while exposing switch semantics
use native checked and disabled state as the authoritative control state
provide focus-visible, forced-colors, target-size, and reduced-motion presentation
consumer: provide a localizable accessible name describing the dark-theme setting
map checked state to the application light or dark theme
own persistence, system-preference policy, and application theme orchestration

notes: Theme Toggle is a specialized binary light/dark presentation over the approved checkbox-backed switch semantic baseline.
Checked means dark theme and unchecked means light theme; system-theme selection remains application policy rather than a third switch state.
The sky illustration is decorative and must not be the only indication of state; thumb position and native checked semantics remain authoritative.
